corpus_notes: All ten are press releases by BIS: one publisher's account of its own actions. Several BIS releases are not independent corroboration of one another.
Each text is the one BIS's News & Updates listing embedded on the retrieval date. Two were also checked against separately retained release pages; the others are labelled as listing text.
BIS's site records later changes to most of these pages, so the wording at first release is not established.

The rule texts, Federal Register documents and other linked documents were not retained. “Not stated in this source” describes the retained text only: the matter may be settled in a document not read here.

method_note: The releases were chosen by reading the records that the snapshot's semiconductor keyword filter matched; the filter is a word list, not a classification, and it also matches unrelated releases. Every statement below is tied to quoted text; supply-chain stages are the curator's reading of the items each release names.
not_claimed: That any release caused a change in trade, prices, production or company results.
That the January 2026 policy repealed or reversed an earlier rule.
That the AI Diffusion Rule was formally rescinded on any particular date.
That policy stayed the same between two selected releases.
That the selection describes the complete or current set of rules.
That several BIS releases corroborate one another.
Any legal, compliance, investment or trading conclusion.
